notes.title: TRAINING
notes.notes:
👉 From April 15, discover the "Training" game mode.
The one if will allow you to have checkpoints. (this will avoid having to start all over again).

Attention, no reward and levels will be unlockable in this game mode.
Prepare yourselves !



Thanks for playing the game.
